Project.title: Project
Project.description: Dynamic QR project representing a client installation with editable OneDrive destination URL

id.description: Unique identifier of the installation project

projectName.description: Name or description of the installation

shortCode.description: Short code used in dynamic URL /r/{shortCode}

destinationUrl.description: Current target URL in OneDrive or SharePoint

destinationHistory.description: Audit trail of previous destination URLs

qrTargetType.description: Whether QR encodes dynamic redirection or direct link

qrDesign.description: Visual customization settings for the QR sticker

scanCount.description: Total number of times this QR code was scanned

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp when project was created

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp when project was last updated

lastScannedAt.description: ISO timestamp of most recent scan

AppUser.title: AppUser
AppUser.description: Technician or administrator authorized in the installation manager

name.description: Full name of the technician or user

active.description: Whether the user account is active

ScanEvent.title: ScanEvent
ScanEvent.description: Event logged when a QR code sticker is scanned

id.description: Unique identifier of the scan event

clientName.description: Name of the client at time of scan

projectName.description: Name of the project at time of scan

/projects/{projectId}.description: Installation projects and their dynamic QR configuration

/scans/{scanId}.description: Scan analytics events logged by camera visits
